_help: Ride Guide behaviour for every route. Change a number, then Commit changes: the live site updates in about two minutes. A value that is missing or out of range falls back to the default shown in its _help line, so a typo cannot break the app.

announce._help: Spoken directions. firstWarningMetres: say 'In 150 metres, ...' this far before a turn (default 160, 60 to 400). turnMetres: say the turn itself this far before it (default 35, 10 to 80). cautionWarningMetres: first warning for a caution cue (default 120, 60 to 400). skipFirstWarningIfCuesCloserThanMetres: when two cues are this close, skip the early warning for the second (default 110, 0 to 300). mergeNextCueWithinMetres: when the next cue is this close, add 'Then ...' to the current one (default 90, 0 to 250).

offRoute._help: metres: further than this from the line counts as off route (default 50, 25 to 150). readings: how many GPS readings in a row before warning (default 3, 1 to 10). repeatSeconds: repeat the warning this often while off route (default 60, 20 to 600).

stops._help: triggerMetres: open a stop when the rider is this close (default 60, 20 to 200). cautionWarningMetres: warn of a caution stop this far ahead (default 90, 30 to 300).

screen._help: Starting settings for riders who have not changed them. keepScreenOn (default true), batterySaver (default false), readStoriesAloud (default true): point of interest stories for a ride that has no stories value of its own in routes.json; each ride sets its own on the Ride Guide Settings page. wakeBeforeTurnMetres: battery saver lights the screen this far before a turn (default 250, 80 to 1000). blackoutAfterSeconds: battery saver blacks out after this long with no taps (default 20, 5 to 120).

speeds._help: Average km/h used for riding time estimates (defaults: ebike 15, bike 13, walk 4.5, kayak 5).
